items.context: 虽然他昨天病了，但是他还是来上班了。

distractors.rationale: A causal accepted premise would motivate the result; the declared relation instead contrasts the actual circumstance with what happened.
A causal accepted premise would motivate the result; the declared relation instead contrasts the actual circumstance with what happened.

items.register: neutral narrative; the concession is a realized past event

semantic.validatorVersion: inherited model (model ID not independently observable)
reasons: The completed sentence naturally reports that he came to work despite having become ill yesterday.
虽然 expresses the realized concession. 因为 would assert causation and 既然 would present a premise for an inference; neither expresses the declared concession here.

但是 and 还是 reinforce the concession, but this judgment is semantic rather than a rigid requirement to pair connectors. Only 虽然 meets the declared reading among the offered alternatives; coverage is MCQ recognition only.

items.context: 虽然天气很冷，他还是去游泳了。

distractors.rationale: A causal accepted premise would motivate the result; the declared relation instead contrasts the actual circumstance with what happened.

items.register: neutral narrative; the concession is a realized fact and the second clause reports what happened

semantic.validatorVersion: inherited model (model ID not independently observable)
reasons: The completed sentence naturally reports swimming despite the realized fact of cold weather.
虽然 expresses the declared realized concession. 既然 and 因为 present reasons or premises instead, so they do not meet that reading.
还是 supports the concessive meaning without establishing an exclusive connector pairing rule. Only 虽然 meets the delivered constraints among the offered alternatives; coverage is MCQ recognition only.

items.context: 即使明天下雨，我也不会取消比赛。

distractors.rationale: This causal connector asserts or accepts the first clause as a reason; it does not itself express concession to an unconfirmed possibility.
This causal connector asserts or accepts the first clause as a reason; it does not itself express concession to an unconfirmed possibility.

items.register: spoken determination; the first clause is an unconfirmed possibility, not an asserted fact or accepted cause; the connector itself must express that the outcome holds despite that possibility

semantic.validatorVersion: inherited model (model ID not independently observable)
reasons: The completed sentence naturally expresses determination to hold the competition even in the unconfirmed event of rain tomorrow.
即使 itself expresses the hypothetical concession. 既然 presupposes an accepted premise and 因为 asserts a cause; neither meets the explicitly unconfirmed concessive reading.
也 alone does not make arbitrary connectors hypothetical concessives. Only 即使 meets the delivered constraints among the offered alternatives; coverage is MCQ recognition only.

items.context: 即使这次失败了，我也不会放弃。

distractors.rationale: This causal connector asserts or accepts the first clause as a reason; it does not itself express concession to an unconfirmed possibility.
This causal connector asserts or accepts the first clause as a reason; it does not itself express concession to an unconfirmed possibility.

items.register: spoken determination; the first clause is an unconfirmed possibility, not an asserted fact or accepted cause; the connector itself must express that the outcome holds despite that possibility

semantic.validatorVersion: inherited model (model ID not independently observable)
reasons: The completed sentence naturally expresses determination not to give up even if this attempt fails. 了 is compatible with a hypothetical completed failure and does not by itself assert that failure occurred.
即使 expresses the required hypothetical concession. 既然 presupposes an accepted premise and 因为 asserts causation, contrary to the declared reading.
Only 即使 meets the delivered constraints among the offered alternatives; this does not claim exclusivity across all possible Chinese expressions. Coverage is MCQ recognition only.

grammar.meaning: consequence based on an accepted premise

items.context: 既然大家都到了，我们就开始吧。

distractors.rationale: This concessive connector presents an obstacle despite which the result holds, rather than the accepted premise motivating the response.
This concessive connector presents an obstacle despite which the result holds, rather than the accepted premise motivating the response.

items.register: spoken; the reason is presupposed and the predicate is a suggestion

semantic.validatorVersion: inherited model (model ID not independently observable)
reasons: The completed sentence is natural spoken Chinese: everyone having arrived is accepted as the basis for suggesting that the group begin.
既然 expresses the presupposed reason. 即使 changes it to a hypothetical concession; 虽然 changes it to a realized concession, neither of which satisfies the declared relation.
就 supports an inference here but is not treated as an exclusive pairing rule. Only 既然 meets the constraints among the offered alternatives; coverage is MCQ recognition only.

items.context: 既然你已经决定了，我就不反对了。

distractors.rationale: This concessive connector presents an obstacle despite which the result holds, rather than the accepted premise motivating the response.

items.register: spoken; the reason is presupposed and the predicate is the speaker's response

semantic.validatorVersion: inherited model (model ID not independently observable)
reasons: The completed sentence naturally treats the decision as an accepted premise for the speaker ceasing opposition.
既然 expresses the declared presupposed reason. 即使 gives a hypothetical concession; 虽然 gives a concessive relation rather than the required premise-to-response relation.
就 does not establish a rigid connector pairing. Only 既然 meets the delivered constraints among the offered alternatives; coverage is MCQ recognition only.

correctionPromptGuidelines: Correct tones in pinyin when the learner writes pinyin.
Do not replace a valid regional Mandarin expression merely with a preferred synonym.
